messages.content:
You are the Input Tester inside FlowLens. You designed input cases for a form; code executed them in fresh browser sessions. For each case you get your inputs and expectation, and the facts the browser recorded afterwards (URLs, headings, status and alert messages, invalid fields, visible text).

Judge each case only from those recorded facts:
- "as_expected": the facts match the expectation.
- "unexpected": the facts contradict the expectation.
- "unclear": the facts are insufficient, or the expectation itself is not stated by a requirement.

Reply with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{"reasoning": "<short>", "assessments": [
  {"case": <case number>, "verdict": "as_expected" | "unexpected" | "unclear",
   "observed_summary": "<what the facts show>", "requirement_ref": "<id or null>"}]}

Your verdicts are unverified candidates. A separate verifier checks them independently.

Supplied requirements:
- R1: A creator can start a new draft from the dashboard.
- R2: A draft has a title and a caption.
- R3: Saving a draft keeps its title and caption. After a page reload, the saved values are still shown.
- R4: A creator can schedule a post from the dashboard by giving a post title and a publish date.
- R5: A publish date in the past must be rejected: the form shows a validation message and no post is scheduled. "Past" means before the studio date shown on the scheduling form.

Form: http://localhost:5174/drafts/new (New draft)

Case 1: Valid Draft Submission
  inputs: {"Title": "My First Post", "Caption": "This is a test caption."}
  requirement: R3
  expected: The draft is saved and the title and caption remain visible on the page.
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/new", "url_after": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/04a80367?saved=1", "title": "Edit draft · Creator Studio", "headings": ["Edit draft"], "status_messages": ["Draft saved."], "alert_messages": [], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Creator Studio Dashboard Edit draft Draft saved. Title Caption Save changes"}

Case 2: Empty Title Check
  inputs: {"Title": "", "Caption": "Caption with no title"}
  requirement: R2
  expected: The system should indicate if a title is mandatory to satisfy the requirement that a draft 'has' a title.
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/new", "url_after": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/ee4fdb8c?saved=1", "title": "Edit draft · Creator Studio", "headings": ["Edit draft"], "status_messages": ["Draft saved."], "alert_messages": [], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Creator Studio Dashboard Edit draft Draft saved. Title Caption Save changes"}

Case 3: Empty Caption Check
  inputs: {"Title": "Title with no caption", "Caption": ""}
  requirement: R2
  expected: The system should indicate if a caption is mandatory to satisfy the requirement that a draft 'has' a caption.
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/new", "url_after": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/dd5a2488?saved=1", "title": "Edit draft · Creator Studio", "headings": ["Edit draft"], "status_messages": ["Draft saved."], "alert_messages": [], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Creator Studio Dashboard Edit draft Draft saved. Title Caption Save changes"}

Case 4: Long Text Persistence
  inputs: {"Title": "A Very Long Title That Might Wrap Around the Screen", "Caption": "A very long caption intended to test the storage and display limits of the draft saving mechanism to ensure data integrity."}
  requirement: R3
  expected: The full long strings are saved and correctly displayed after the page processes the save.
  execution: executed
  recorded facts: {"url_before": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/new", "url_after": "http://localhost:5174/drafts/5327b2dd?saved=1", "title": "Edit draft · Creator Studio", "headings": ["Edit draft"], "status_messages": ["Draft saved."], "alert_messages": [], "invalid_fields": [], "text_excerpt": "Creator Studio Dashboard Edit draft Draft saved.
